title: DOTr to announce flights affected by 49th ASEAN Summit
summary: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) said Friday it would announce next week the flights that could be affected by the arrival of heads of state and other activities during the 49th ASEAN Summit…

blocks.text: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) said Friday it would announce next week the flights that could be affected by the arrival of heads of state and other activities during the 49th ASEAN Summit in Metro Manila on November 16 to 18.
